result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 1 against AC-1.1 through AC-1.4, including the Convex archive entry mutation/query, schema and PlatformStore wiring, shared archive contracts, documented TC mappings, the local test harness, and the configured story/epic gates.

newFindings.title: Story 1 scope and evidence requirements conflict, leaving AC-1.1 and AC-1.4 unproven
newFindings.evidence: The story scope explicitly defers live finalization hooks, archive read routes/UI, and read-time provenance enrichment to later stories (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/stories/01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:36-38`, `174-178`), but the same story still requires TC-1.1a/b/c and TC-1.4a/b coverage (`.../01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:156-166`, `192-199`; `docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/test-plan.md:36-44`). Those mapped files do not exist (`tests/service/server/archive-finalization.test.ts`, `tests/service/server/archive-api.test.ts`), `rg` found no `ArchiveFinalizationService`/`appendFinalizedEntry` or `ArchiveReadService`/`getArchive` implementation under `apps/platform/server/services`, and the only executable proof is the Convex handler test (`convex/archiveEntries.test.ts:196-236`, `370-436`). That leaves finalized user/model/process-event archival and degraded related-context reads without the required story-level evidence.

newFindings.title: The production archive read path paginates after loading the full process archive
newFindings.evidence: `listArchiveEntries` reads `by_processId_and_sequence` with `.collect()` and only then slices in `paginateArchiveEntries` (`convex/archiveEntries.ts:139-155`, `261-280`). The story/design describe this store method as returning one bounded page (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/stories/01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:126-127`; `docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/tech-design.md:661-668`). The outward page contract is correct, but long-process production reads still materialize the full archive in memory.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/archiveEntries.test.ts --environment node

productionPathFindings: `convex/archiveEntries.ts:139-155` uses `collect()` plus in-memory slicing for `listArchiveEntries`, so long-process archive reads are not yet bounded at the persistence layer.
openQuestions: Should Story 1 be accepted on primitive-only evidence, or are TC-1.1 and TC-1.4 intentionally still in-scope despite the scope notes that defer finalization hooks, archive API, and provenance enrichment to Stories 2, 3, and 6?
additionalObservations: No fake adapter, shim, placeholder branch, or compatibility workaround was found in the inspected production archive persistence path; the runtime path is the real Convex mutation/query plus the real ConvexPlatformStore call-through.
Both configured gates passed locally; the remaining blockers are requirement/scope proof gaps rather than format, lint, type, build, or test failures.
